meta.title: Autorestart — restart continuation
meta.description: Keeps agent work alive across a DeepSeek Harness restart: a durable checkpoint, goal re-arm or a continuation message on boot, and an idle-aware graceful restart the agent can request itself.

backupChoice.title: Automatic pre-restart backup: include the installed plugins too?
backupChoice.body: A snapshot of the current configuration is taken before every restart, so a host that fails to come back can be rolled back automatically.
backupChoice.withPluginsHint: About 3 seconds and 117 MB more; a plugin that breaks the boot can be rolled back too.
backupChoice.configOnlyHint: Instant, about 66 KB; plugin problems cannot be rolled back and need a manual reinstall.
backupChoice.footnote: You can change this later in Settings → Auto-restart & shut down

seconds.label: Shutdown countdown seconds
seconds.hint: Once every conversation is done, this countdown is shown on screen (pick "Never mind, keep it on" to cancel); the machine goes off when it reaches zero. Raise it when you want more time to write.

restartGrace.label: Wait before the restart
restartGrace.hint: A restart has no countdown: the host restarts as soon as the conversations are done. Raise this if you rely on a memory or summary plugin that writes its notes after the conversation ended (default 0 seconds).

backup.label: Backup before a restart
backup.hint: Take a snapshot of the current configuration before every restart, so a host that cannot boot again is rolled back automatically.

backupPlugins.label: Include the installed plugins in the backup
backupPlugins.hint: Off: only the state of DSH itself is backed up — the plugin directory of the profile is left out.

button.label: Shut down
button.aria: Graceful shutdown: wait for every session to finish, then power off
button.title: Waits for every session to finish, counts down {n} seconds, then powers off
button.titleImmediate: Waits for every session to finish, then powers off right away (no countdown)

choice.title: Keep the graceful shutdown button?
choice.body: It lives at the very bottom of the left sidebar, next to the Settings button: one click waits for every session to finish, counts down and powers the machine off.
choice.keepHint: One moon button at the bottom of the left sidebar: one click to shut down gracefully.
choice.hideHint: The interface stays as it is; turn it on again in the settings whenever you want it.
choice.footnote: You can change this later in Settings → Auto-restart & shut down
choice.diagramLabel: The button sits at the bottom of the left sidebar, next to Settings

announcement.title: New feature: graceful shutdown
announcement.line1: There is a new 🌙 "Shut down" button at the very bottom of the left sidebar.
announcement.line2: Click it → once every conversation is done it counts down {n} seconds and powers the machine off.
announcement.line2Generic: Click it → once every conversation is done it counts down a few seconds and powers the machine off.
announcement.line3: To change that, go to "Settings → Auto-restart & shut down".
announcement.disabled: The button is currently switched off; you can turn it on in the settings.
